shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar FileInput ThemeProvider Toaster Tabs && sed -n '1,115p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar FileInput ThemeProvider Toaster && sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'README.md"'$|FileInput|Avatar.d.ts|Select.d.ts|Switch.d.ts|Checkbox.d.ts|TextInput.d.ts|Button.d.ts'"' | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -65 && ls -a"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md && rg -n '"'^#|Required setup|useFileInput|--g-color-base-brand|--g-color-base-selection|--g-color-line-focus'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -85 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'brand|selection|focus|link|border-radius|spacing|background' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -130 && cat tsconfig.json index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -35 && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg -n 'Person|Globe|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUp|Check|Chevron|CircleQuestion|ArrowRightFrom|Camera|Lock|Gear|ArrowLeft' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist/index.d.ts | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/AvatarText.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'interface ControlProps|interface AriaLabelingProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n 'base-brand|line-focus|text-brand|base-background|base-float' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Person|Globe|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUpFromLine|Check|ChevronDown|CircleQuestion|Camera|Lock|ArrowLeft|CircleCheck|ArrowUpFromSquare|CircleInfo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -60 && sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-brand|base-selection|text-brand|line-focus|line-brand|text-link)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -3"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && rg -n 'avatar_size_xl|size_xl|--g-avatar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css | head -20 && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && sed -n '60,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css && sed -n '120,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js && sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts"
